描述_EN: this means that, although it is only in one colour, the design stands out because the diagonal line of the twill goes in the opposite direction to that of the background. this weave technique was particularly popular in china between the 10th century and the 14th century, although it was first introduced at an earlier date and continued in use in later times. this palmette-patterned silk is a twill damask.
描述_ZN: 这意味着，尽管它只有一种颜色，但由于斜纹的对角线与背景的对角线方向相反，所以设计很突出。 这种编织技术在10世纪和14世纪之间在中国特别流行，尽管它在更早的时候被首次引入，并在后来的时代继续使用。 这种棕榈花纹的丝绸是一种斜纹大马士革。
